summary.zh: Sophon 链停止运行,11 月 25 日前要把币提回以太坊。
summary.en: The Sophon chain shuts down; withdraw to Ethereum by Nov 25.

deadlineNote.zh: 这天以后,官方桥不再处理从 Sophon 提回以太坊的提现。
deadlineNote.en: After this date the official bridge stops processing withdrawals from Sophon to Ethereum.

todo.zh: 用**官方桥**把 Sophon 上的币提回以太坊主网。提现要等几个小时,别拖到最后一天。
todo.en: Use the **official bridge** to withdraw your tokens from Sophon to Ethereum. Withdrawals take a few hours, so don't leave it to the last day.

caution.zh: 只从官方公告里的链接进官方桥;私信你的「客服」都是骗子。
caution.en: Only open the bridge from the link in the official announcement. Anyone who DMs you as support is a scammer.

summary.zh: Abstract 链 12 月 15 日关停。
summary.en: The Abstract chain shuts down on Dec 15.

deadlineNote.zh: 这天以后链停止出块,链上的资产就取不出来了。
deadlineNote.en: After this date the chain stops producing blocks and assets on it can no longer be moved.

todo.zh: 把 Abstract 上的币跨回以太坊主网,或者转到支持 Abstract 充值的交易所。
todo.en: Bridge your tokens from Abstract back to Ethereum, or send them to an exchange that accepts Abstract deposits.

name.zh: opBNB 上的 CAKE 停止跨链

summary.zh: opBNB 上的 CAKE 11 月 23 日以后不能再跨回 BNB Chain。
summary.en: CAKE on opBNB can't be bridged back to BNB Chain after Nov 23.

who.zh: opBNB 上有 CAKE 的人。

deadlineNote.zh: 这天以后,opBNB 上的 CAKE 不能再跨回 BNB Chain。
deadlineNote.en: After this date CAKE on opBNB can no longer be bridged back to BNB Chain.

todo.zh: 先从 PancakeSwap 的 opBNB 池子里撤出,再把 CAKE 跨回 BNB Chain。
todo.en: Remove your liquidity from PancakeSwap's opBNB pools first, then bridge your CAKE back to BNB Chain.

summary.zh: OldVault 的取款入口 10 月 31 日已经关闭。
summary.en: OldVault's withdrawal page closed on Oct 31.

who.zh: 在 OldVault 里存过钱的人。

deadlineNote.en: The withdrawal page closed on this date.
